verified_facts.text: Meadowood is a 250-acre wine-country estate in Napa Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: our 250-acre wine-country estate invites our guests into the family and community life of Napa Valley

verified_facts.text: The estate runs from the ridges of the surrounding mountains through wooded canyons and rows of vineyards to the Napa River's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: the estate unfolds from the ridges of its surrounding mountains through wooded canyons and rows of vineyards to the Napa River’s edge

verified_facts.text: Napa Valley is about an hour's drive north of San Francisco.
verified_facts.excerpt: Napa Valley, just an hour’s drive north, has emerged as one of the world’s most prestigious winegrowing regions

verified_facts.text: Meadowood has long served as a gathering place for Napa Valley residents and common ground for local vintners and winegrowers.
verified_facts.excerpt: it has served as a gathering place for Napa Valley residents and common ground for local vintners and winegrowers

verified_facts.text: The accommodations are set amid the trees of the Meadowood estate and furnished for privacy, relaxation and restoration.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set amid the trees of the Meadowood estate, our Napa Valley accommodations are elegantly furnished for privacy, relaxation, and restoration.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have private porches, with fireplaces, soaking tubs, window seats and sofas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms all have private porches and while they are open-planned and airy, the fireplaces, soaking tubs, window seats and comfy sofas keep things cozy.

verified_facts.text: The Hill House is a one-bedroom retreat on the wooded hillside next to the Meadowood Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled into the wooded hillside next to the Meadowood Spa, this expansive, one-bedroom retreat

verified_facts.text: The Hill House has a terrace with a deep soaking tub and outdoor shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sheltered off the bedroom, another terrace luxuriates in a deep soaking tub and outdoor shower.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Tree House Retreat is partly open to the elements, with a fireplace and a hand-hammered copper tub for custom baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: Partly open to the elements, the room includes a fireplace and a hand-hammered copper tub for custom baths.

verified_facts.text: The spa's outdoor relaxation lounges have a dry cedar sauna, steam room, plunge pool and outdoor rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the outdoor relaxation lounges, we have a dry cedar sauna, steam room, plunge pool (cool or hot depending on the season), and an outdoor rain shower.

verified_facts.text: The spa has separate men's and women's garden lounges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Separate men’s and women’s garden lounges offer additional calm and respite.

verified_facts.text: Wooded hillsides frame the five outdoor tennis courts, with pros on call.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wooded hillsides frame our five immaculately maintained outdoor courts. With our dedicated pros on call

verified_facts.text: The estate's hiking trails give panoramic views of St. Helena and the ridges of Napa Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in panoramic views of St. Helena and the ridges that form Napa Valley.

verified_facts.text: A morning hike on the southern trail often brings views of hot air balloons in the distance over the vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: A morning hike on the southern trail often provides magical moments with hot air balloons in the distance over glistening vineyards.

verified_facts.text: One hiking trail ends at a secret meditation labyrinth.
verified_facts.excerpt: several miles of hiking trails with a secret meditation labyrinth at the end of one trail

verified_facts.text: The Wine Center covers all aspects of wine appreciation and the world's wine regions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn about all aspects of wine appreciation and the world’s various regions of production.

verified_facts.text: The Wine Center is exclusive to Meadowood guests, Meadowood Club Members and The Napa Valley Reserve Members.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Wine Center is exclusive to Meadowood guests, Meadowood Club Members, and The Napa Valley Reserve Members.

verified_facts.text: Forum is the central restaurant, serving Napa Valley cuisine indoors and out.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our central restaurant and convivial gathering space, Forum provides an elegantly relaxed approach to Napa Valley cuisine with gracious service in an open and lively setting both indoors and out.

verified_facts.text: The chefs use ingredients fresh from Meadowood Farm and the surrounding communities.
verified_facts.excerpt: ingredients fresh from Meadowood Farm and the surrounding communities

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to bicycles for exploring on and off the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to bicycles for on- and off-estate exploring

verified_facts.text: The property is about three miles from the shops and restaurants of downtown St. Helena.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property is about three miles from the shops and restaurants of downtown St. Helena.

verified_facts.text: Meadowood has a club, so members from St. Helena and elsewhere in Napa are often at the pool, at lunch or on the tennis courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meadowood has a club component, so it’s common to see members who live in the nearby town of St. Helena or elsewhere in Napa at the pool, having lunch, or taking a tennis lesson

verified_facts.text: The pool complex welcomes the entire family.
verified_facts.excerpt: our swimming complex welcomes the entire family
